record.issue_text: No fetch timeout or size cap is set on the `open()` fetches, so retrieval/poll jobs can be hung or OOM'd

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces multiple network fetches via Ruby’s `open-uri` without any explicit timeouts or size limits: `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` in `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb` and `Readability::Document.new(open(url).read, ...)` in `app/models/topic_embed.rb#import_remote`. These run in background jobs (`Jobs::PollFeed`, `Jobs::RetrieveTopic`/`TopicRetriever`) and can hang indefinitely on slow/unresponsive endpoints or read arbitrarily large responses into memory (`.read`), risking job starvation or OOM. This is a verifiable defect in the added code paths.
